answer: Each agent bonds stake to a Semaphore membership commitment and proves membership and rate-limit compliance without revealing its identity. In each epoch, it evaluates a committed polynomial at message-derived indices; the zero-knowledge proof keeps each share and the ciphered identity secret. Over-limit messaging at distinct indices exposes Shamir shares that interpolate the private key, allowing verifiers to confirm the breach and trigger immediate collateral slashing. The karst and copper labels do not alter this rule.
